description: The EUR/USD rate the XRP Ledger DEX implies through the EUR registry stablecoin against each USD registry stablecoin, and its basis to the ECB reference rate. When to use: To measure, from the XRP Ledger's own order books and AMM pools, the EUR/USD rate the DEX implies through the EUR registry stablecoin against each USD registry stablecoin, and how far it sits from the ECB reference rate. Prefer another tool: To measure how far one registry stablecoin trades from its peg against another registry coin (use `/v1/xrpl/metrics/peg`), or to read an order book or an AMM pool (use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook` or `/v1/xrpl/amm/{a}/{b}`). Example: xrpl_metrics_fx_basis {}
name: xrpl_metrics_fx_basis

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

legs.description: EURØP, the EUR registry coin, priced in each USD registry coin, one leg per coin in registry order (RLUSD, USDC)

basis_bps.description: Basis of implied_usd_per_eur against the ECB rate in basis points, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null without a route or without a stored ECB rate

implied_usd_per_eur.description: Median of the observed prices of the leg's routes, USD per EUR; null without a route

routes.description: The available routes only, in the order clob_direct, amm_direct, via_xrp

deviation_bps.description: Deviation of observed from the ECB rate in basis points, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null without a stored ECB rate

observed.description: USD per EUR implied on this route: the price of the EUR coin in the leg's USD coin

route.description: clob_direct: mid of the EUR coin's book against the leg's USD coin; amm_direct: fee-free spot of their pool; via_xrp: mid of XRP in the USD coin over mid of XRP in the EUR coin

usd_asset.description: The USD registry coin of the leg (RLUSD or USDC), as CODE.issuer (40-hex code)

reasons.description: no_route when a leg has no route; reference_rate_unavailable without a stored ECB rate; empty otherwise

anyOf.description: ECB reference the bases are measured against; null only without a stored ECB rate

age_days.description: Whole UTC days from rate_date to the answer's date

rate_date.description: Date of the stored ECB rate (YYYY-MM-DD)

source.description: Attribution of the rate: "Source: ECB statistics"

usd_per_eur.description: Stored ECB reference rate, USD per EUR, unmodified

usd_leg_spread_bps.description: Basis of the RLUSD leg minus basis of the USDC leg, from the unrounded bases, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null unless both legs have a basis

warnings.description: stale_reference when the stored ECB rate is stale; empty otherwise

title: XRPL FX basis
